purpose: Test one bounded composition of two independently frozen mechanisms: add V93's deterministic SRPT/critical-path player order to the already parent-complete faithful-FaaSRank profiles from V83/V86; for E4 retain the V85/V87 idle-warm dominance initializer.

frozen_predecessor_evidence.V93_mechanistic_conclusion: V93 dispatched the SRPT-ready exact OCS/Jiagu initializer unchanged in every player window. The ready frontier materially improved throughput over V91/V92, but the exact native initializer did not retain the low latency-cost product needed for QPR. Further guard tuning is excluded.

independent_component_evidence.V83_relevant_result: The faithful-FaaSRank terminal-OCS window-safe profile passed throughput and both QPR gates in its preregistered screen, with 3051 accepted coordination windows.
independent_component_evidence.V86_relevant_result: The dual FaaSRank-plus-OCS certificate passed all three gates in its preregistered screen and preserved the frozen initializer anchor.
independent_component_evidence.V87_relevant_result: Terminal OCS exceeded the frozen E3 throughput maximum for spike and sustained; idle-warm dominance exceeded the frozen E4 QPR maximum. Both already used the parent-complete frontier but retained native request iteration rather than V93's SRPT/critical-path order.

mechanism.family: parent-complete SRPT-ready faithful-FaaSRank anchor with terminal-OCS dual-window coordination
mechanism.E3_definition: Collect only functions whose parents have completed, order requests by ascending outcome-blind remaining workflow work and functions by descending critical-path rank, initialize with faithful sequential FaaSRank while routing terminal functions through OCS, then retain the frozen dual FaaSRank-plus-OCS complete-window Pareto guard.
mechanism.E4_definition: Use the same parent-complete SRPT-ready frontier and faithful FaaSRank/terminal-OCS path, retain the frozen idle-warm structural substitution and initializer dominance certificate, then retain the frozen dual complete-window guard.
mechanism.single_intended_change_from_frozen_compo: Only enable the already frozen V93 SRPT/critical-path ordering flag on the already parent-complete V86 terminal-OCS dual-window profile and V85 idle-warm variant. No frontier, score coefficient, guard tolerance, objective, feasibility rule, HPA rule, workload, or outcome-derived threshold changes.

targeted_tests_required: both profiles use parent-complete collection and deterministic SRPT order
both profiles use the faithful FaaSRank initializer and terminal-OCS router
E3 uses the dual FaaSRank-plus-OCS window certificate
E4 retains idle-warm dominance and its initializer certificate

training_gate.per_scenario_rule: The complete E720-E722 arithmetic mean must be finite and strictly greater than the frozen maximum advanced-baseline mean for all three metrics; ties fail.
training_gate.joint_rule: All four scenarios must pass before any V94 confirmation plan may be written or E723-E725 may be opened.
training_gate.blindness_rule: Capture all three parent tapes, derive all nine burst tapes, build all 12 references, and run all 12 processes before producing one result-blind audit. Reveal performance exactly once only after identities, hashes, attempt counts, QC, pairing, reference provenance, exact coverage, and unopened confirmation inputs pass.
training_gate.failure_action: Retain the complete V94 cohort, do not consume E723-E725 or V93's E716-E718, do not selectively rerun, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
training_gate.success_action: Freeze both V94 profiles and binary without further tuning, preregister exactly E723-E725, and require a separate blind confirmation audit before paper-group closure.
